title: Scientific Normalization & Acceptance Semantics for the Bounded Richards Temporal Indicator

selected_candidate.budget_owner: explicit numerical/application accuracy policy outside the F-SI25 estimator

executed_checks.exact_linear_budget_implication: C_h<=1 implies qualified exact-linear endpoint head error <= H_budget

scientific_interpretation.exact_linear_scope: Within the already qualified exact-linear dissipative scope, B_inf retains its theorem-qualified infinity-norm bound meaning. Therefore C_h<=1 has a genuine exact-linear endpoint head-error implication relative to an externally supplied H_budget.
scientific_interpretation.nonlinear_scope: Within the currently qualified nonlinear Richards envelope, C_h is only normalized consumption of the bounded stiffness-aware indicator budget. C_h<=1 does not prove true nonlinear endpoint head error <=H_budget.
scientific_interpretation.why_no_internal_tolerance: Existing evidence does not provide a source-bound universal head scale, and deriving one from owner/held-out matrices, legacy convergence tolerances, finite refinement endpoints, or the F-KT09 <=1 interface would be empirical or semantic overreach.
scientific_interpretation.why_no_M_only_normalization: B_M is an M-weighted head norm, not a mass-balance residual; hard mass conservation remains a separate absolute gate.
scientific_interpretation.retry_warning: F-VQ28 forbids assuming that retry halving monotonically improves a temporal indicator on the evolving nonlinear trajectory.

qualified: The non-empirical dimensionless candidate C_h=B_inf/H_budget is scientifically and dimensionally coherent when H_budget is an explicit positive finite head-domain numerical/application budget with independent provenance.
No universal default H_budget is admitted by F-SI26.
The candidate is compatible with the already-qualified generic F-KT09 model-owned certificate surface without changing F-KT09 semantics.
Exact-linear true-bound implications are preserved only inside the already-qualified exact-linear scope.
Nonlinear Richards semantics remain explicitly weaker: indicator-budget consumption, not a proven nonlinear true-error guarantee.

Invalid budget, unavailable indicator, unsupported operator envelope, invalid continuation provenance, initial no-history, restart mismatch or discontinuity remain fail-closed/unavailable unless separately qualified.
hard_nonclaims: No numeric H_budget value or scientific application tolerance is selected.
No general nonlinear true-error upper bound is claimed.
N512 or any finite refinement endpoint is not promoted to truth.
No empirical multiplier, safety factor, q_cap, Nmin, tail model, floor inflation or state coefficient is introduced.
No monotone shorter-dt certificate improvement is assumed.
No production temporal acceptance/retry policy is admitted.
No production bootstrap/restart/discontinuity continuation mechanism is admitted.
No F-GC02, groundwater-coupling or F-PE release follows.
